dict.Durata muncii, cu orele suplimentare, nu: Working time, overtime included, may not exceed 48 hours a week on average; overtime is worked only with the employee's agreement (except in emergencies).
dict.La „Termen depășit” suma se socotește cu: For “Deadline passed” the amount is worked out with the premium for the uncompensated hours. The rules change by law and by the collective agreement: check them with your accountant.
dict.Orele lucrate peste program de fiecare a: The hours each employee worked beyond the schedule, compensated with time off or paid with a premium: you get the compensation deadline (60 days, editable), the hours left, the amount to pay with the 75% premium and the status: compensated (green), to compensate (yellow), deadline passed (red); on the right the totals and the hours of a chosen employee.
dict.Orele suplimentare se compensează întâi: Overtime is first compensated with paid time off, within the deadline under “Rules”; if that is not possible, it is paid with a premium (at least 75% of the base salary).
dict.Cererea firmei către angajați pentru ore: The company's request to employees to work beyond the schedule: the reason, the days and hours for each employee, how it is compensated (time off within 60 days or payment with a premium), each employee's signed agreement and the director's approval
